{{Quote|On whose authority?''"<br />"''CorSec. I'm working on behalf of Commander Talte.|[[Jareck Arned]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DASL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: A Solitary Life|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Talte''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was an officer of the [[Corellian Security Force]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Actually, I heard only a few days ago that Commander Talte in Doaba Guerfel was concerned about some citizens disappearing.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jark]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ANA" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Talte held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] within the [[Corellian Security Force]] and was assigned to the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:ANA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he recruited a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had previously worked with his colleague, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jark]], in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:ANA" />

Commander Talte had a problem with people going missing and sent the spacer to discover the cause of it.<ref name="SWG:ANA" /> The missing people were hikers who disappeared in the [[Nomad Mountains|Thaos Mountains]]. The spacer questioned [[Angela]], the wife of one of the missing hikers [[Ilyamo]], to learn more about the trail. The spacer also interrogated [[Myron Beech]] who organized the hiking trail.<ref name="SWG:GI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Gathering Information|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer later met [[Jareck Arned]] who was living a solitary life in the mountains and searched his [[Valley home|home]] that was located on the hiking trail.<ref name="SWG:DASL" /> However, another group of people suddenly disappeared. The spacer immediately went to the spot where the second group disappeared where he fought several [[cave-dwellers]],<ref name="SWG:DFtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Finding the Culprits|Corellia}}</ref> an anti-government and criminal group.<ref name="SWG:DFR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Final Reckoning|Corellia}}</ref> From a communicator found on a body, Commander Talte managed to triangulate a signal to a [[Psychotic cave-dwellers' cave|cave]]. Talte thus ordered the spacer to rescue the hostages before they were executed.<ref name="SWG:DFtC" /> Commander Talte's agents finally assaulted the cave and freed the hostages. The cave-dweller leader [[Raynod Menar]] was killed by the spacer during the attack.<ref name="SWG:DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Talte appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ANA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Commander Talte was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
